intro_text.en: Start with a practical situation,draw the model,and solve one step at a time.
intro_text.gu: Practical પરિસ્થિતિથી શરૂ કરીએ,model દોરીએ અને એક-એક પગલે ઉકેલીએ.

h.en: 4.1.1 Same load, different bar, different response

body.en:
Start with a situation

A thick tie rod and a thin tie rod carry the same load, but their stress and extension differ.

Definition

Average direct normal stress sigma=P/A; linear engineering strain epsilon=Delta L/L.Stress describes internal force intensity; strain describes relative deformation.

Understand the reason

Use an axial centric load and a suitable uniform section away from local load effects. Tension lengthens; compression shortens under the chosen sign convention.

Example / application

Halving area doubles average stress at the same load.

Remember / avoid this mistake

Average stress is not every local peak near a notch, hole or load introduction.
body.gu:
એક પરિસ્થિતિથી શરૂઆત કરીએ

જાડો અને પાતળો tie rod સરખો load લે,પણ stress,extension જુદાં હોય.

ચોક્કસ વ્યાખ્યા

Average direct normal stress sigma=P/A;linear engineering strain epsilon=Delta L/L.Stress internal force intensity અને strain relative deformation બતાવે.

હવે કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Axial centric load અને local load effectsથી દૂર uniform section લો.Chosen sign મુજબ tensionમાં length વધે,compressionમાં ઘટે.

ઉદાહરણ / ઉપયોગ

Load સરખો રાખી area અડધું કરીએ તો average stress બમણો થાય.

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

Average stress notch,hole કે load introductionની દરેક local peak નથી.

h.en: 4.1.2 Elasticity, Hooke law and Young modulus

body.en:
Definition

Elasticity is recovery after unloading within appropriate limits. The elastic limit is the limiting stress for no permanent deformation under the stated test conditions. The proportional limit bounds linear stress-strain behaviour.

In uniaxial linear elasticity, sigma=Eepsilon; E is Young modulus. Constant-area extension delta=PL/(AE).For stepped bars sumNi Li/(Ai Ei) with signed internal axial force Ni.

Remember / avoid this mistake

Elastic behaviour need not always be linear. Hooke law is not valid through plastic yielding or fracture.
body.gu:
ચોક્કસ વ્યાખ્યા

Elasticity યોગ્ય limitsમાં unloading પછી recovery છે.Elastic limit stated test conditionsમાં permanent deformation વગરની limiting stress છે.Proportional limit linear stress-strain behaviourની limit છે.

Uniaxial linear elasticityમાં sigma=Eepsilon;E Young modulus છે.Constant-area extension delta=PL/(AE).Stepped barsમાં signed internal force Ni સાથે sum Ni Li/(Ai Ei) લો.

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

Elastic behaviour હંમેશાં linear હોવું જરૂરી નથી.Hooke law plastic yielding/fracture સુધી લાગુ નથી.

body.en:
Given

Bar:P40 kN, A400 mm², L2000 mm, E200000 N/mm²; linear axial elasticity.

Stepwise solution

  1. sigma=40000/400=100 MPa
  2. epsilon=sigma/E=100/200000=.0005
  3. delta=epsilon L=.0005×2000=1 mm

Remember / avoid this mistake

UseN, mm, N/mm² consistently; strain has no unit and can be stated as500microstrain.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી

Bar:P40kN,A400mm²,L2000mm,E200000N/mm²;linear axial elasticity.

એક-એક પગલે ઉકેલ

  1. sigma=40000/400=100MPa
  2. epsilon=sigma/E=100/200000=.0005
  3. delta=epsilon L=.0005×2000=1mm

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

N,mm,N/mm² consistent લો;strain dimensionless છે,500microstrain પણ લખી શકાય.

body.en:
Understand the reason

The initial straight region gives E; then the curve leaves proportionality and approaches yielding. Mild steel may show upper/lower yield points and a yield plateau.

Strain hardening raises engineering stress to ultimate tensile strength(UTS); necking then reduces load/original-area engineering stress until fracture.

Engineering stress uses original area; true stress uses current local area. A falling engineering curve after necking does not mean the minimum-section true stress must fall.

Example / application

UTS=Pmax/A0; percentage elongation=(Lf−L0)/L0×100; percentage reduction in area=(A0−Af)/A0×100.

Remember / avoid this mistake

Yield features depend on material and test conditions; do not force an upper/lower plateau onto every metal.
body.gu:
હવે કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

શરૂઆતના straight regionનો slope E આપે;પછી proportionality છોડીને yielding આવે.Mild steelમાં upper/lower yield points,yield plateau દેખાઈ શકે.

Strain hardeningથી engineering stress UTS સુધી વધે;પછી neckingથી load/original-area engineering stress ઘટતાં fracture થાય.

Engineering stress original area, true stress current local area લે.Necking પછી engineering curve ઘટે એટલે minimum-section true stress જરૂર ઘટે એવું નહિ.

ઉદાહરણ / ઉપયોગ

UTS=Pmax/A0;percentage elongation=(Lf−L0)/L0×100;percentage reduction in area=(A0−Af)/A0×100.

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

Yield features material,test conditions પર આધારિત;દરેક metal પર upper/lower plateau ન લાદો.

body.en:
Given

Illustrative A0=100 mm², L0=50 mm; maximum load45 kN, final gauge length62.5 mm, minimum final area60 mm².

Stepwise solution

  1. UTS=45000/100=450 MPa
  2. Elongation=(62.5−50)/50×100=25%
  3. Reduction in area=(100−60)/100×100=40%

Remember / avoid this mistake

These are teaching values, not an actual performed test; final dimensions must be measured by the specified test method.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી

Illustrative A0=100mm²,L0=50mm;maximum load45kN,final gauge length62.5mm,minimum final area60mm².

એક-એક પગલે ઉકેલ

  1. UTS=45000/100=450MPa
  2. Elongation=(62.5−50)/50×100=25%
  3. Reduction in area=(100−60)/100×100=40%

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

આ teaching values છે,કરેલા testનો report નહિ;final dimensions specified test methodથી માપવા જોઈએ.

h.en: 4.1.6 Lateral strain, Poisson ratio and volumetric strain
h.gu: 4.1.6 Lateral Strain,Poisson Ratio અને Volumetric Strain

body.en:
Definition

Poisson ratio nu=−epsilon lateral/epsilon longitudinal for uniaxial loading in the applicable elastic range. Tension commonly causes lateral contraction.

Lateral strain is not lateral stress. A freely contracting tensile bar has approximately zero lateral surface stress; restraint can create lateral stresses.

For small strains, volumetric strainev=epsilon x+epsilon y+epsilon z. For uniaxial stress:sigma/E×(1−2nu).

Remember / avoid this mistake

Use the minus sign in the definition; do not call a negative contraction strain a negative conventional nu automatically.
body.gu:
ચોક્કસ વ્યાખ્યા

Applicable elastic rangeમાં uniaxial loading માટે Poisson ratio nu=−epsilon lateral/epsilon longitudinal.Tensionમાં સામાન્ય રીતે lateral contraction થાય.

Lateral strain એટલે lateral stress નહિ.Freely contracting tensile barની lateral surface stress લગભગ zero;restraint હોય તો lateral stresses બને.

Small strains માટે volumetric strain ev=epsilon x+epsilon y+epsilon z.Uniaxial stressમાં:sigma/E×(1−2nu).

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

Definitionમાં minus sign રાખો;negative contraction strainથી conventional nuને આપમેળે negative ન કહો.

h.en: 4.1.7 Shear, bulk and elastic moduli relations

body.en:
Definition

Average shear stresstau=V/A for the stated shear plane; small shear strain gamma is change in a right angle in radians; G=tau/gamma in linear shear elasticity.

Bulk modulus K=−p/ev for positive compressive hydrostatic pressurep and signed volumetric strainev.

For homogeneous isotropic linear elasticity:E=2G(1+nu)=3K(1−2nu); E=9KG/(3K+G).

Remember / avoid this mistake

These isotropic relations are not universal for composites or anisotropic materials; engineering shear strain is an angle, not a length.
body.gu:
ચોક્કસ વ્યાખ્યા

Stated shear plane માટે average shear stress tau=V/A;small shear strain gamma એટલે right angleનો radiansમાં ફેરફાર;linear shear elasticityમાં G=tau/gamma.

Positive compressive hydrostatic pressure p અને signed volumetric strain ev માટે bulk modulus K=−p/ev.

Homogeneous isotropic linear elasticity માટે E=2G(1+nu)=3K(1−2nu);E=9KG/(3K+G).

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

આ isotropic relations composites/anisotropic materials માટે universal નથી;engineering shear strain angle છે,length નહિ.

body.en:
Given

Uniaxial stress100 MPa, E200000 MPa, nu.30; initial diameter20 mm, volume100000 mm³.

Stepwise solution

  1. epsilon long=.0005; epsilon lateral=−.30(.0005)=−.00015
  2. Delta d=−.00015×20=−.003 mm
  3. ev=.0005(1−.60)=.0002; Delta V=20 mm³
  4. G=200000/[2(1.30)]=76923.08 MPa
  5. K=200000/[3(.40)]=166666.67 MPa

Remember / avoid this mistake

Small-strain, free lateral contraction and isotropic linear-elastic assumptions are essential.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી

Uniaxial stress100MPa,E200000MPa,nu.30;initial diameter20mm,volume100000mm³.

એક-એક પગલે ઉકેલ

  1. epsilon long=.0005;epsilon lateral=−.30(.0005)=−.00015
  2. Delta d=−.00015×20=−.003mm
  3. ev=.0005(1−.60)=.0002;Delta V=20mm³
  4. G=200000/[2(1.30)]=76923.08MPa
  5. K=200000/[3(.40)]=166666.67MPa

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

Small-strain,free lateral contraction,isotropic linear-elastic assumptions જરૂરી છે.

body.en:
Definition

A stepped bar in series carries internal force set by equilibrium; extensions add. A parallel compound member has materials sharing load through defined connections.

Modular ratio compares elastic moduli, e.g.n=Es/Ea. For equal-length bonded parallel members with no slip or initial mismatch, axial strain is common andP=sum(Ei Ai)epsilon.

Compatibility supplies deformation relations; equilibrium supplies force balance; constitutive laws connect stress/strain. All three are needed for load sharing.

Remember / avoid this mistake

Equal strain does not imply equal stress; equal force in series does not imply equal extension.
body.gu:
ચોક્કસ વ્યાખ્યા

Series stepped barમાં internal force equilibriumથી નક્કી થાય;extensions ઉમેરાય.Parallel compound memberમાં defined connectionsથી materials load share કરે.

Modular ratio moduli સરખાવે,જેમ n=Es/Ea.Equal-length bonded parallel membersમાં no slip/initial mismatch હોય તો axial strain common,P=sum(Ei Ai)epsilon.

Compatibility deformation relations,equilibrium force balance અને constitutive laws stress/strainનો સંબંધ આપે.Load sharingમાં ત્રણેય જોઈએ.

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

Equal strain એટલે equal stress નહિ;seriesમાં equal force એટલે equal extension નહિ.

body.en:
Given

Equal-length bonded bars, L1000 mm; steel As200 mm², Es200000 MPa; aluminium Aa400 mm², Ea70000 MPa; total P68 kN, no initial strain.

Stepwise solution

  1. sumEA=200000×200+70000×400=68000000 N
  2. epsilon=68000/68000000=.001; delta=1 mm
  3. sigma s=200 MPa; Ps=40 kN; sigma a=70 MPa; Pa=28 kN
  4. n=200000/70000=2.85714; Ps+Pa=68 kN

Remember / avoid this mistake

The supports/connections enforce common extension in this model; without that compatibility, do not use these load shares.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી

Equal-length bonded bars,L1000mm;steel As200mm²,Es200000MPa;aluminium Aa400mm²,Ea70000MPa;total P68kN,no initial strain.

એક-એક પગલે ઉકેલ

  1. sumEA=200000×200+70000×400=68000000N
  2. epsilon=68000/68000000=.001;delta=1mm
  3. sigma s=200MPa;Ps=40kN;sigma a=70MPa;Pa=28kN
  4. n=200000/70000=2.85714;Ps+Pa=68kN

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

આ modelમાં supports/connections common extension આપે;આ compatibility વગર આ load shares ન લો.

h.en: 4.1.11 Thermal strain:free, restrained and yielding support

body.en:
Definition

Free thermal strain epsilon th=alpha Delta T; free extension=alpha L Delta T with constant alpha. Uniform free heating creates expansion but no restraint stress in this ideal model.

For complete axial restraint and linear elasticity:0=sigma/E+alpha Delta T, so heating produces compressive stress sigma=−Ealpha Delta T.

If supports yield/move apart by delta s, the imposed total strain is delta s/L and sigma=E(delta s/L−alpha Delta T).Here yielding means permitted support movement, not automatically plastic yielding of metal.

Remember / avoid this mistake

A gap allows free movement until it closes. A compliant support needs its force-displacement law, not an assumed zero stress or full-restraint formula.
body.gu:
ચોક્કસ વ્યાખ્યા

Constant alphaમાં free thermal strain epsilon th=alpha Delta T;free extension=alpha L Delta T.Uniform free heatingમાં આ ideal modelમાં expansion થાય,restraint stress નહિ.

Complete axial restraint અને linear elasticityમાં0=sigma/E+alpha Delta T,એટલે heatingમાં compressive stress sigma=−Ealpha Delta T.

Supports delta s જેટલા yield/દૂર ખસે તો imposed total strain delta s/L અને sigma=E(delta s/L−alpha Delta T).અહીં yielding એટલે support movement,આપમેળે metalનું plastic yielding નહિ.

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

Gap બંધ થાય ત્યાં સુધી free movement આપે.Compliant support માટે તેનો force-displacement law જોઈએ,અંદાજે zero stress કે full-restraint formula નહિ.

body.en:
Given

SteelL2000 mm, E200000 MPa, alpha12×10^-6/°C, temperature rise50°C.

Stepwise solution

  1. Free extension=12×10^-6×2000×50=1.2 mm
  2. Rigid supports:sigma=−200000×12×10^-6×50=−120 MPa
  3. Supports move apart.4 mm:sigma=200000(.4/2000−.0006)=−80 MPa

Remember / avoid this mistake

Both answers assume the material remains linear-elastic; if the calculated stress exceeds valid limits, use an appropriate inelastic model.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી

Steel L2000mm,E200000MPa,alpha12×10^-6/°C,temperature rise50°C.

એક-એક પગલે ઉકેલ

  1. Free extension=12×10^-6×2000×50=1.2mm
  2. Rigid supports:sigma=−200000×12×10^-6×50=−120MPa
  3. Supports move apart.4mm:sigma=200000(.4/2000−.0006)=−80MPa

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

બન્ને answersમાં material linear-elastic રહે એમ માન્યું છે;stress valid limitsથી વધી જાય તો યોગ્ય inelastic model જોઈએ.

h.en: 4.1.13 Strain energy, resilience and proof resilience

body.en:
Definition

Strain energy is energy stored in deformation. For a linear axial member U=Pdelta/2=P²L/(2AE)=sigma²V/(2E).

Resilience is the ability to store/release elastic strain energy. Proof resilience is maximum elastic strain energy at the adopted elastic limit; modulus of resilience is proof resilience per unit volume.

With an ideal linear response to limiting stress sigma e, ur=sigma e²/(2E).Some course conventions use yield stress as an approximation; state the chosen limit.

Remember / avoid this mistake

Toughness relates to energy absorption to fracture, not just the elastic area. Resilience is not a synonym for hardness.
body.gu:
ચોક્કસ વ્યાખ્યા

Deformationમાં stored energy strain energy છે.Linear axial member માટે U=Pdelta/2=P²L/(2AE)=sigma²V/(2E).

Resilience elastic strain energy store/release કરવાની ક્ષમતા છે.Proof resilience adopted elastic limit પર maximum elastic strain energy છે;modulus of resilience unit volume દીઠ proof resilience છે.

Limiting stress sigma e સુધી ideal linear responseમાં ur=sigma e²/(2E).કેટલીક course conventionsમાં yield stress approximation લેવાય;chosen limit જણાવો.

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

Toughness fracture સુધી energy absorption છે,ફક્ત elastic area નહિ.Resilience hardnessનો પર્યાય નથી.

body.en:
Definition

A gradually applied final axial force W gives static extension delta st=WL/(AE).For an ideal undamped linear bar, a suddenly applied constant force from zero drop height gives maximum extension2delta st and maximum stress2W/A.

For a weight W falling a heighth onto the bar/load collar, ideal energy balance W(h+delta)=AE delta²/(2L).Thus delta=delta st[1+sqrt(1+2h/delta st)] and sigma max=Edelta/L.

Remember / avoid this mistake

These formulas neglect damping, local contact loss, bar mass, waves and plasticity; an impact is not universally just twice static stress.
body.gu:
ચોક્કસ વ્યાખ્યા

Gradually applied final axial force W માટે static extension delta st=WL/(AE).Ideal undamped linear barમાં zero drop heightથી sudden constant force લાગતાં maximum extension2delta st,stress2W/A મળે.

Weight W bar/load collar પર h heightથી પડે તો ideal energy balance W(h+delta)=AE delta²/(2L).એટલે delta=delta st[1+sqrt(1+2h/delta st)] અને sigma max=Edelta/L.

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

Formulasમાં damping,local contact loss,bar mass,waves,plasticity અવગણાય;impact હંમેશાં ફક્ત બે ગણો static stress નથી.

body.en:
Given

W1000 N, A100 mm², L1000 mm, E200000 MPa; ideal axial bar; fallh2 mm.

Stepwise solution

  1. delta st=1000×1000/(100×200000)=.05 mm; sigma st=10 MPa
  2. Sudden h0:delta max=.10 mm; sigma max=20 MPa
  3. Fall h2:factor=1+sqrt(1+2×2/.05)=10
  4. delta max=.5 mm; sigma max=100 MPa
  5. Energy check:W(h+delta)=1000(2+.5)=2500 N·mm=2.5 J=AEdelta²/(2L)

Remember / avoid this mistake

The weight does additional work while the bar extends; omitting W delta underestimates the energy input.

Quick check: Is sudden load the same as arbitrary impact?

No. The factor2 is the ideal zero-drop undamped linear case.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી

W1000N,A100mm²,L1000mm,E200000MPa;ideal axial bar;fall h2mm.

એક-એક પગલે ઉકેલ

  1. delta st=1000×1000/(100×200000)=.05mm;sigma st=10MPa
  2. Sudden h0:delta max=.10mm;sigma max=20MPa
  3. Fall h2:factor=1+sqrt(1+2×2/.05)=10
  4. delta max=.5mm;sigma max=100MPa
  5. Energy check:W(h+delta)=1000(2+.5)=2500N·mm=2.5J=AEdelta²/(2L)

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

Bar extend થાય ત્યારે પણ weight work કરે;Wdelta છોડવાથી input energy ઓછી ગણાય.

જાતે વિચારો: Sudden Load એટલે કોઈપણ Impact?

ના.Factor2 ideal zero-drop,undamped linear case માટે છે.

body.en:
Given

Adopted sigma e250 MPa, E200000 MPa, volume100000 mm³; linear to the chosen limit.

Stepwise solution

  1. ur=250²/(2×200000)=.15625 N/mm²=.15625 N·mm/mm³
  2. Proof resilience=ur V=15625 N·mm=15.625 J

Remember / avoid this mistake

Energy density can be expressed inPa orJ/m³ with correct conversion; do not confuse it with total energy inJ.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી

Adopted sigma e250MPa,E200000MPa,volume100000mm³;chosen limit સુધી linear.

એક-એક પગલે ઉકેલ

  1. ur=250²/(2×200000)=.15625N/mm²=.15625N·mm/mm³
  2. Proof resilience=ur V=15625N·mm=15.625J

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

Energy density યોગ્ય conversionથી Pa કે J/m³માં લખાય;total energy J સાથે ન ભેળવો.

h.en: 4.1.17 How to build a stress answer

body.en:
Build an exam answer

  1. Isolate the member, show axial force/constraints, identify material and geometry, state small-strain/linear-elastic assumptions, then apply equilibrium+compatibility+constitutive relation.
  2. For energy loading write the work-energy balance first. For thermal problems distinguish free movement, rigid restraint and yielding supports before substituting.
body.gu:
પરીક્ષામાં જવાબ ગોઠવીએ

  1. Member isolate કરો,axial force/constraints દોરો,material,geometry ઓળખો,small-strain/linear-elastic assumptions આપો,પછી equilibrium+compatibility+constitutive relation લો.
  2. Energy loadingમાં પહેલાં work-energy balance લખો.Thermalમાં substitution પહેલાં free movement,rigid restraint,yielding supports જુદાં કરો.
